title: Ozark Fall
subtitle: Fungi, fruit and colour, September to November

items.label: Chicken of the Woods
items.hint: Shelves of bright orange and yellow on a dead trunk

items.label: Turkey Tail
items.hint: Thin banded fans, velvety, white pore underside

items.label: Giant Puffball
items.hint: A white ball in the grass, sometimes football sized

items.label: Oyster Mushroom
items.hint: Pale shelving caps, gills running down a stubby stem

items.label: Jack-o'-Lantern
items.hint: Dense orange clump at a stump base. Glows faintly. Toxic

items.label: Hen of the Woods
items.hint: Grey feathered rosette at the foot of an oak

items.label: Earthstar
items.hint: A puffball sitting in a split star of leathery rays

items.label: Stinkhorn
items.hint: You will smell it before you see it. Slimy dark tip

items.label: Bird's Nest Fungus
items.hint: Cups a few mm wide holding egg-like spore packets

items.label: Dead Man's Fingers
items.hint: Blunt black clubs pushing out of rotting wood

items.label: Witch's Butter
items.hint: Gelatinous yellow blobs on a damp fallen branch

items.label: Sugar Maple in colour
items.hint: Five lobes, orange to scarlet, the classic one

items.label: FREE
items.hint: Free space

items.label: Sassafras
items.hint: Mitten, thumbless and two-thumbed leaves on one tree

items.label: Persimmon fruit
items.hint: Orange, plum sized, only edible once frost-soft

items.label: Pawpaw fruit
items.hint: Green mango shape hanging in a shady bottom

items.label: Black Walnut husk
items.hint: Green tennis ball that stains your hands brown

items.label: Hickory nut
items.hint: Four-sectioned husk splitting off a pale nut

items.label: Osage Orange
items.hint: Brain-textured green sphere, heavy, under a hedge tree

items.label: Goldenrod
items.hint: Arching plumes of tiny yellow flowers on a roadside

items.label: Aster
items.hint: Purple rays with a gold centre, late and cold-tolerant

items.label: Monarch
items.hint: Orange with black veins, heading south

items.label: White-throated Sparrow
items.hint: Striped crown, yellow spot by the eye. Arrives in October

items.label: Woolly Bear
items.hint: Black and rust banded caterpillar crossing a road

items.label: Beaver sign
items.hint: A gnawed stump or a fresh cut sapling by water
